implementations.name: merge
implementations.summary: Interleave two sorted slices into one sorted Vec - the merge step of merge sort, taken in isolation.
implementations.vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [1,4,7,2,3,9], run(a) { const mid = 3; const left = []; const right = []; for (let i=0;i<mid;i++) left.push(a.get(i)); for (let i=mid;i<a.length;i++) right.push(a.get(i)); let i=0,j=0,k=0; while (i<left.length && j<right.length) { a.cursor('i',i); a.cursor('j',j); if (left[i] <= right[j]) { a.set(k, left[i]); a.mark(k,'from-a'); i++; } else { a.set(k, right[j]); a.mark(k,'from-b'); j++; } k++; } while (i<left.length) { a.set(k, left[i]); a.mark(k,'from-a'); i++; k++; } while (j<right.length) { a.set(k, right[j]); a.mark(k,'from-b'); j++; k++; } a.markSorted(); } })

implementations.name: unquote
implementations.summary: Strips one matched pair of leading/trailing quotes (single or double) from a token; leaves it unchanged if the quotes don't match or aren't a full wrap.

tests.name: install.rs

implementations.vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [34,108,101,102,116,45,112,97,100,34], run(a) { const first=a.get(0); const last=a.get(a.length-1); const isQuote=c=>c===34||c===39; const matched = a.length>=2 && isQuote(first) && last===first; a.cursor('i',0); a.mark(0, matched?'quote':'kept'); for (let i=1;i<a.length-1;i++){ a.cursor('i',i); a.mark(i,'kept'); } a.cursor('i',a.length-1); a.mark(a.length-1, matched?'quote':'kept'); a.markSorted(); } })

implementations.name: blueprint_cli
implementations.summary: The bsc blueprint CLI surface — a CliSpec over the shared bsc-json-store runner.

note: The COMMITTED, build-readable graph store. Authoring happens in the runtime store (~/.base-studio-code/knowledge/algorithms.json); `bsc graph promote` moves records here, and `bsc graph promote --check` is the gate. Read directly, never through bsc_graph::load(), because load() reconciles the packaged seed and would append it wholesale.
